findings.reason: decimal.js:2153 now only validates rm and never assigns Ctor.rounding, so undefined is passed to divide(x, y, 0, rm, 1). Because pr=0, divide does not fill in rm (2759-2761), and finalise's roundUp at 3011-3013 is false for undefined on an exact half. This contradicts the doc comment at 2120-2121.
findings.claim: When y is given and rm is omitted, toNearest no longer defaults rm to Decimal.rounding, so exact halfway values round toward zero (e.g. new Decimal(1.5).toNearest(1) gives 1 instead of 2 under the default ROUND_HALF_UP).
findings.evidence: The diff removes `if (rm === void 0) { rm = Ctor.rounding; }` and replaces it with `if (rm !== void 0) checkInt32(rm, 0, 8);`, so `rm` stays undefined. It is then passed through `divide(x, y, 0, rm, 1)`. Because pr=0 is not null, divide does not set rm (lines 2759-2761). It reaches `finalise`, where `rm < 4` is false for undefined and none of the `rm == 4 / 6 / 7 / 8` checks match (lines 3011-3017), so an exact half (rd==5, not truncated) never rounds up. The doc comment at line 2120-2121 says `Decimal.rounding` applies when rm is omitted. No locked test calls toNearest with a non-null y, no rm, and an exact half, so the tests do not catch this.

findings.reason: Line 2168 does remap only rm 1 and 3, while decimal.mjs:2166 remaps all rm < 4. The diff shows the baseline decimal.js had no remapping at all, so modes 0 and 2 behave as they did before. There is no story.md in the packet to show whether full remapping was asked for.
findings.claim: The added mode remapping handles only ROUND_DOWN (1) and ROUND_FLOOR (3). ROUND_UP (0) and ROUND_CEIL (2) are not mapped to their half-modes, which goes against the doc comment and differs from decimal.mjs:2166 (rm < 4).
findings.evidence: Line 2168 has `if (rm === 1 || rm === 3) rm = [4, 5, 7, 8][rm];` even though the lookup table has entries for indices 0 and 2. The doc comment at lines 2123-2124 says 'rounding mode 4 (ROUND_HALF_UP) is the same as rounding mode 0 (ROUND_UP), and so on'. decimal.mjs:2166 has `if (rm < 4) rm = [4, 5, 7, 8][rm];` and also does not default rm, and the diff leaves decimal.mjs unchanged.
